Tucker’s final Mission 🤍 When we wrote Tucker’s book, we never imagined we’d be sharing it without him. This was a project we poured our hearts into long before his passing, and we had dreamed of celebrating its release together. Although our hearts are broken and our world has completely changed, our hope is that this final chapter of Tucker’s story can bring love, comfort, and hope to others, just as he did throughout his life. 🎗️ For children battling cancer: You can sponsor a book and Tucker squishy bundle that will be donated to a child fighting cancer through our participating children’s hospitals and nonprofit partners. Our dream is to reach every child diagnosed this year. ❤️ For the fight against cancer: We’ve personally donated $8,000 to Morris Animal Foundation’s Golden Retriever Lifetime Study, a groundbreaking study investigating cancer in Golden Retrievers, and $2,000 to Blood Cancer United’s Dare to Dream Project, which funds groundbreaking research and clinical trials to develop safer, less toxic, and more effective treatments for children with blood cancer, with fewer long term side effects. With your help, we’re hoping to reach our fundraising goals of $50,000 for Morris Animal Foundation and $75,000 for Blood Cancer United in Tucker’s honor. Every contribution brings us one step closer.  You can sponsor a book bundle, donate directly, and follow our fundraising progress through our page. This was never how we imagined sharing Tucker’s book with the world 😭 He was supposed to be here for this. But we hope something beautiful can come from something so heartbreaking. Thank you for helping us carry on his legacy 🩵
